ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems.

2. When practising Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Reader, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Reader.

   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library?

14. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. No full stops
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

15. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)

   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only a joining word
